newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Ahold has no comment on Karstadt.
newsitem.headline: Ahold has no comment on Karstadt.

text.p: Dutch supermarket group Ahold NV declined to comment on Thursday on rumours it was interested in taking over German retailer Karstadt and said it had no immediate ambitions in the German market.
"As you know, it is our policy not to comment on market rumours," Ahold spokesman Hans Gobes said.
"But our strategy is to focus on what we consider as growth regions and we are not changing that strategy. Germany, the United Kingdom and France are not part of our strategy," he added.
Ahold, which took over U.S. supermarkets chain Stop & Shop last year, indicated in May of this year it intended to seek further expansion on the American east coast.
It also said it saw healthy growth possibilities in Asia, Latin America and Eastern Europe.
